title: Nine A particles on a 3x3 grid, spacing 3.5: pairwise additivity at N = 9 in the flat-K domain
pitch: Our flat A-A law (K = 18, P = 2.5, P-0003 domain 3 to 6) is measured for pairs only. Nearest neighbours here sit at 3.5, the next at 4.95, the rest at 7.0, so every pair is in or near the flat domain. Pre-registered prediction: pairwise sum of the flat law from rest, computed before any result (analysis/make_2026-11-21_grant.py). Rule: RMSE/L of the pairwise-sum model at most 0.01 supports additivity at N = 9 (noise floor 0.007); above 0.02 means the pairwise sum or the flat K fails at 3.5 to 7. One run, 100 samples, tracker and census. Cost about 1.1 of the 120-credit award.
